mapper.sql: CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS definitionId, CAST(v.id AS CHAR) AS versionId, f.flow_key AS flowKey, f.flow_name AS flowName, f.model_type AS modelType, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.definition_json AS definitionJson
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM fcc_flow_definition f JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id = f.id WHERE f.flow_key = #{flowKey} AND v.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM fcc_flow_definition f JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id = f.id WHERE f.model_type = #{modelType} AND v.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC, f.id LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM fcc_flow_definition f JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id = f.id WHERE v.id = #{versionId} LIMIT 1
